generationRecords.actualPromptText:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production 2D side-scroller enemy sprite animation sheet for Aliens: Tantalus Frontier
Primary request: Create ONE high-detail pixel-art sprite sheet of the project's original Reef Spitter ecophenotype, animation idle.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat, perfectly uniform opaque pure MAGENTA #FF00FF filling every background pixel and every empty gap.
Subject identity lock: the SAME original amphibious xenomorph in every cell and across all four animation sheets. Lean medium-sized ranged caste, front torso held higher than a Reef Stalker, eyeless narrow smooth raised cranium, recognizable xenomorph ribbed torso, exactly two long clawed arms and two digitigrade legs, double jaw, long laterally compressed swimming tail, fine restrained aquatic dorsal plates. Wet blue-black and dark blue-green chitin. ONE modest inflatable acid gland under the throat only, yellow-acid color and biologically connected to the mouth. No giant chest sacs.
Style/medium: crisp detailed arcade pixel art, controlled readable clusters and hard silhouette; never photorealistic, never painterly or soft 3D.
Composition/framing: exact 2:1 landscape canvas split conceptually into FOUR equal columns by TWO equal rows; exactly EIGHT individually authored chronological poses in strict row-major order. One complete creature per cell, gameplay side view facing RIGHT. Identical anatomy, rigid skull length, palette, physical scale and camera in all cells. Body and entire tail fit comfortably inside about 70% of each cell width with generous equal gutters. No cell overlap and no crop.
Animation: Subtle grounded idle loop. Pose 1 neutral alert; poses 2-4 slow throat-sac inhale and mild upper-torso lift; pose 5 peak modest gland expansion under the throat; poses 6-8 relax smoothly back near pose 1. Mouth stays closed or barely parted. No acid stream or detached projectile.
Production invariants: consistent ground-contact baseline except clearly airborne action where specified; eight genuinely distinct consecutive poses, never copied or repeated. The throat gland, mouth line, hands, feet and full swimming tail remain readable. No turning toward camera.
Constraints: no text, labels, numbers, UI, logo, watermark, panel borders, grid lines, scenery, rocks, water, bubbles, floor, ground line, reflection, shadow, checkerboard, transparency preview, extra creatures, extra limbs, weapon, biological cannon, tube or fish mouth. No pink or magenta lighting/reflection/fringe on the anatomy. Background must remain exactly #FF00FF.
Canon statement: this is a project-original marine adaptation of the Spitter/Ranger function, not an official exact caste and not a 1:1 canon claim.
